title: Check for an iPhone update
aliases: how do i check for an iphone update
is my phone up to date
see if there is a new ios version

steps.instruction: Wait for the update check to finish. This screen will show whether an update is available.

source_note: Settings on iOS 26/27, English, October 2026 documentation review. An internet connection is needed. This guide only checks availability; it does not download or install an update. Managed phones and connection errors can change the result shown. Not checked on a phone. Source: https://support.apple.com/en-ie/118575
